name: Baanah
description: David's compatriots living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Ishbosheth had two captains of bands, Baanah and Rechab, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite of the children of Benjamin, for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin; and the Beerothites had fled to Gittaim.

David answered Rechab and Baanah that as the Lord liveth, who had redeemed his soul out of all adversity, the man who told him Saul was dead, thinking to bring good tidings, he had taken hold of and slain in Ziklag; that was the reward he gave for such tidings.

cases.name: Baanah and Rechab
cases.charge: Murder of Ish-bosheth on his bed at noon, and carrying his head to David for a reward
cases.preview: When Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.
